result.title: Efficient probabilistic weather forecasting at quarter-degree resolution with two-sided transport attention
result.comment: 32 pages, 6 figures, 7 Extended Data figures, 1 Extended Data table
result.summary: High-resolution probabilistic weather forecasting remains computationally demanding. Here we present Astra, a 0.25$^\circ$ ensemble model trained on eight H200 GPUs. It combines Kantorovich Attention, a two-sided transport attention in which each region chooses where it reads from and writes to, so every region sends and receives at token resolution, with a self-featurised continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) that also scores forecasts in the model's multiscale features. In WeatherBench 2, Astra matches GenCast's CRPS averaged over five upper-air targets and days 1-10 with 9.8% of its hardware-normalised training compute. Verified against ERA5, its CRPS and ensemble-mean root-mean-square error are lower than the ECMWF ensemble's on all 600 variable, level and lead-time combinations, and its CRPS is lower than GenCast's on 73.5% of them. A 15-day member needs 39 times fewer floating-point operations than GenCast's GPU implementation, and 50 members take under 40 min on one consumer GPU, within 21 GB.

AI.brief_summary: Astra 是一个 0.25° 分辨率的集合概率天气预报模型，结合双向「Kantorovich Attention」（各区域自主选择读写位置）与在模型多尺度特征上打分的自特征化 CRPS，以远少得多的算力达到 GenCast 级 CRPS。
AI.relevance_reason: 其中「每区域自行选择从哪里读取、向哪里写入」的 token 级路由可能为 VLM 的视觉证据筛选与 latent 状态读写结构提供可核查线索；在特征空间而非输出空间打分的 CRPS 也可能启发 latent 表示的概率性评价，但迁移性尚待核查。
